jobs.description: The University of Houston is seeking a Commissioned Law Enforcement Officer to protect persons and property on campus. Responsibilities include patrolling, enforcing laws, responding to calls, and conducting investigations. Applicants must be TCOLE certified, at least 21 years old, and able to pass background checks and drug screenings. The role involves varying shifts including nights and weekends. Veterans are encouraged to apply, and military experience related to law enforcement is preferred. Competitive salary commensurate with experience. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Strong knowledge of police practices and excellent communication skills are essential. Join us to contribute to campus safety while engaging positively with the university community. #J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs.title: Campus Safety Patrol Officer – Protect Students
jobs.description:
Young World Physical Education in Houston, Texas, is seeking a Patrol Police Officer. This full-time role involves protecting students and staff, enforcing laws, and maintaining safety within Alief ISD.

The ideal candidate must hold a high school diploma or GED and a Texas Peace Officer License. Responsibilities include patrolling the district, responding to emergencies, and collaborating with other police agencies.

The position offers a competitive salary ranging from $63,857 to $88,115 based on experience and is expected to work 260 days a year.
